packageRules.description: Updates to GitHub Actions should be tagged as 'ci'

publish-on-central 9.2.5+ crashes every real Maven Central release with NoSuchMethodError: Job.invokeOnCompletion$default (Gradle bundles kotlinx-coroutines-core 1.10.2 internally, incompatible with the Ktor client bundled since 9.2.5) -- see build.gradle.kts and https://github.com/DanySK/publish-on-central/issues/1804. Pinned to 9.2.4 until that's fixed upstream.
